scientific_integrity: The all-prime claim is supported by a self-contained elementary proof; finite checks independently corroborate identities but do not certify all primes. Novelty is assessed relative to literature whose most relevant 2026 full text and indexed repository proofs were inaccessible.
scientific_limitations: Noncollinear three-site supports in the additive prime plane only.
No bound on distance from zero or numerical stability.
An equivalent older formulation may exist in uninspected full text.
title: Sharp cyclotomic field obstruction for positive three-atom Fourier zeros
